Definition
[Weakly lower semicontinuous functional] 1. ch8:8.2.1-def-4\group Existence of Minimizers We say that a function $I[\cdot ]$ is (sequentially) weakly lower semicontinuous on $W^{1,q}(U)$, provided \[ I[u] \leq \liminf _{k \to \infty } I[u_k] \] whenever \[ u_k \rightharpoonup u \text{ weakly in } W^{1,q}(U). \]
